text:
Anya Patel: kicking off a quick RC for the metrics-service change -- want to get the artifact pinned and a short sign-off before we promote to prod. build: `metrics-service:2026.03.21-rc1`
Jamie Cruz: tagging in ops + @Sheriff Alex for go/no-go. any open db migration concerns?
Sheriff Alex: nothing blocking from infra side. migration is a noop flag flip, verified in staging. will be on call for the promo window.
Lisa Nguyen: docs + release notes are updated: https://internal.docs/release-notes/metrics-service/2026-03-21
Kevin M.: rollback plan? if the new RC causes latency regressions we want a clear quick rollback (artifact and traffic pin).
Anya Patel: rollback plan: immediate artifact pin to `metrics-service:stable` and traffic-shim to route 100% back. I have the rollback runbook in the ticket.
Deploy Bot: [deploybot] request approved -> queued for candidate creation (job 98234).
Deploy Bot: [deploybot] candidate build complete: metrics-service:2026.03.21-rc1 (sha: d4c3f2a)
Jamie Cruz: verified smoke on canary-staging, kv cache warmed. tagging @Lisa to confirm telemetry dashboards are green.
Lisa Nguyen: telemetry looks good (p50/p95 within baseline). small uptick in memory under high RPS, but within tolerances.
Sheriff Alex: ack from oncall. recommending canary -> small prod traffic (5%) then ramp if stable.
Anya Patel: proposing timeline: 15:10 canary promo, 15:25 assessment, 15:30 ramp to 100% if green. any objections?
Kevin M.: ok by me. make sure the deploybot has the abort hook if latency > 20% at p95.
Deploy Bot: [deploybot] initiating promotion -> canary (5%). ID: promo-98234-canary
Anya Patel: starting smoke test runbook now:
```\ncurl -s -X POST https://staging.metrics/api/v1/healthcheck
# run the perf scripts: ./scripts/loadtest --duration 60 --qps 200
```
Jamie Cruz: smoke tests pass locally, no errors in logs.
Deploy Bot: [deploybot] canary telemetry: p50 28ms, p95 120ms (baseline p95 115ms), error-rate 0.02%
Lisa Nguyen: small p95 delta but error-rate steady. I recommend proceed to staged ramp to 50%.
Sheriff Alex: executing watchlist, will call abort if >15% p95 regression or any error spike.
Deploy Bot: [deploybot] ramping to 50% -> promo-98234-stage1
Anya Patel: rolling release notes: bumping version tags and publishing changelog now.
Deploy Bot: [deploybot] ramp complete: 50% stable, no alerts in last 5 minutes.
Kevin M.: final question — are there any dependent services pinned to the old client? specifically query-proxy?
Jamie Cruz: query-proxy is compatible. we ran integration tests with rc1 earlier today.
Anya Patel: ok landing: promoting to 100% now.
Deploy Bot: [deploybot] promoting to 100% -> promo-98234-final
Deploy Bot: [deploybot] promotion complete: metrics-service:2026.03.21-rc1 now serving 100% traffic
Lisa Nguyen: post-promo dashboards look nominal. p95 back to 116ms.
Sheriff Alex: oncall clear. no rollback needed.
Anya Patel: thanks team — marking RC as promoted and closing the loop in the ticket: TKT-4512. will follow up with the postmortem if any issues arise. :party_popper:
Jamie Cruz: nice work everyone :thumbsup:
Deploy Bot: [deploybot] ticket updated: TKT-4512 -> status: promoted, pinned artifact: metrics-service:2026.03.21-rc1
